item.title: Building a plotter (part 1)
item.description:
Building a plotter (part 1)

About two years ago I finally pulled the trigger and purchased a 3D printer. Now I missed the Great Fun™ part of the 3D printing hobby where you spent more time hardware hacking than actually printing. My 3D printer just works. It’s a utility. Sure I got to upgrade it from a bed slinger to a core-XY, but there was never any doubt that it would work at the end of the upgrade.
